name: held-out example
wording: an example withheld from builders and used only in judgment, so passing the visible examples while missing the concept is caught; it is withheld by omission, not by instruction or mechanism: it is kept in the repository with the rest of the conceptual design, but outside every work package and never named in anything a builder is given, and builders are never told that held-out examples exist, because a prohibition would announce them; when one fails they learn the concept and the shortfall but not the case, and a case revealed to fix it becomes visible and is replaced by a new held-out one.
reason: decided in 0005: Held-out examples by omission
